FAIL_TO_PASS: super-class-prototype-values: correctly resolves the prototype of the super class when reading property values
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
plugin-attributes-resolveid: allows plugins to read and write import attributes in resolveId
destructured-known-arguments: tracks known argument values through destructuring
property-keys-not-renamed: does not rename property keys
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
unused-parameters: removes arguments that correspond to unused parameters
interop-default: handles interop "default" with live-bindings support
optional-chaining-namespace: supports optional chaining with namespace objects
side-effects-getters-and-setters: treat getters and setters as function calls
side-effect-e: accounts for local scopes when tested function purity
side-effects-es6-class-expressions: determine side effects in ES6 class expressions
remove-unused-wellknown-hasInstance: removes unused Symbol.hasInstance from objects
return-expressions: Track side-effects of method return values
remove-unused-parameter-props-external-call: removes props that are not used in a function when part of the parameter is passed to an external function
preset-with-override: allows using the "preset" option with overrides
side-effects-static-methods: allow calls to pure static methods to be tree-shaken
deoptimize-computed-keys: deoptimizes computed object property keys
minimal-this-mutation: mutates "this" only if necessary on function calls
optional-chaining-null-values: supports optional chaining for null values
